history.overview: The Plains were once fertile Dragorn farmland, now corrupted by Discord and scarred by war.

timeline.name: Agricultural Era
timeline.description: Dragorn farmers cultivated the fertile plains.

timeline.name: Muramite Assault
timeline.description: Muramite forces burned fields and seized control.

timeline.name: Discord Bleed
timeline.description: Discord cracks opened, corrupting wildlife and terrain.

timeline.name: Resistance Operations
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established hidden shelters across the plains.
